fields.AN_Notes: Formal hypercube framework for intersectional fairness with proofs, a variance-based metric family (VarRatio) and verification on synthetic data and the Adult dataset. Studientyp Konzept: the core contribution is the framework, the propagation algorithm and the metrics; the synthetic and real-data experiments serve to verify the theoretical results. Gender, ethnicity and age are the work's own worked examples and the Adult protected attributes (marital status is a further attribute, not coded as a social axis of disadvantage). Indirect_Discrimination: the work defines worst case disparate impact and statistical parity for the outcomes of a binary classification, proves their propagation and finds intersectional bias in Adult; the classification follows the work's own use of disparate impact. Disparate_Performance: section 4.2 and Appendix B extend the framework to Equality of Opportunity, 'that seek to equalize the performance of our model on different subgroups', and prove that worst case accuracy, precision and error-rate disparities narrow up the levels; this rests on the work's own derivation and is not measured empirically. Gender is binary by construction (binary protected attributes, male/female). No mitigation is applied; bottom-up fairness is a design principle without a stage. Theory reference: Crenshaw's intersectionality from Black feminist scholarship frames the problem.

fields.AN_Notes: Practice guide for managers and staff in small and medium enterprises with the KI-FAIRNESS prompting framework, organisational measures and own image-prompt trials in DALL-E 2 and Midjourney. Publication type admitted as scholarly grey literature (university publisher, named authorship, source list, expert contributions), flagged for the domain experts. Other_Task: drafting job advertisements, recommendation letters and company images in HR and marketing. General_Guidance strategy, verbatim: 'Es könnte z.B. explizit gefordert werden, dass Frauen und Männer, Menschen unterschiedlicher Hautfarbe und sozialer Schicht dargestellt werden sollen.' Further strategies: choose the context deliberately, prompt in English ('female and male bosses'), weigh neutrality against explicit diversity, omit gender in recommendation letters or use a 'Verwirrungstaktik', anonymise. Bias axes and harm types rest on the guide's own image-prompt observations and its own job-advertisement argument (Indirect_Discrimination: job-advertisement language that appeals to men deters women and is perpetuated by training); cited news cases are not used. Mitigation status Evaluated applies only to adding 'divers' to the prompt, whose effect is tested in two tools and reported as small; the trial is informal (one prompt), and the other measures (data diversity, targeted training with gender-inclusive terms, governance, training of staff, monitoring, human review) are proposed. Gender understanding: the image analysis contrasts women and men, so Binary_Categorical follows the analysis; the Gender Data Gap remark on genderqueer people, the gender star and 'alle Gender' are conceptual statements that the analysis does not follow. Intersectional rests on the guide's own statement that women and especially Women of Color are sexualised in generated images. Theory reference No: 'Feministische KI' appears only in the outlook as a positive narrative with the MissJourney example, and Data Feminism and the Gender Data Gap appear as further reading or illustration; none of them frames the guide's treatment of gender or bias.
